full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
1950, September 23
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
September 23rd 1950
Blessed be God In all His designs!
God bless you Mrs. Farmer - you and yours.
Here's an envelope which I thing I must have addressed to you early in August, wanting to thank you for your kind favor received some- time befor that; so because I neglected to do that even last Monday when you were here, I'll at least acknowledge same favor. Fr. Gabriel came down Thursday and is conducting the 40 hours Devotion in S S. Peter and Paul Church - our Parish. Everything seems quiet and satisfactory. Deo Gratias.
Pray for the multiplication of vocations and for the conversions of poor sinners. God help us. ... That we be appreciative and make at least some progress towards real gratitude.
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, o.f.m. Cap.
